title: Time Jump: 07:30, First Light and the Riverside Clock

fields.narration: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. It is now 07:30 EDT, Thursday, March 25, 2027. First light is over the Upper Quad, and the heaviest rain the NWS expected is now falling across the Sugar Camp Run basin. The Mill Street gauge reads 7.31 ft and is rising about 1.7 ft per hour. The latest forecast is the 0720 AM Ohio River Forecast Center issuance: 8.0 ft near 8 AM, 10.5 ft near 10 AM, crest 10.8 ft near 10:30 AM. Lot C is ponding along its low edge. Riverside's 680 residents are waking up for 08:00 classes across the Lower Quad, and the Riverside desk phone has not stopped ringing. The Sugar Run Apartments are under whatever advisory you gave at flood stage. The diesel tanker, the Dairy Lane barricade and the Marlowe Fire alternate route stand as you left them. Anything you have not decided is still undecided. The Riverside clearance clock is running whether or not anyone starts it.
worldState: Exercise clock: 07:30 EDT, Thursday, March 25, 2027. First light, heavy rain over the whole Sugar Camp Run basin.
Mill Street culvert gauge: 7.31 ft at 07:30, TREND RISING, about +1.7 ft/hr. Flood stage (7.0 ft) was passed at 07:20.
Latest forecast: Ohio River Forecast Center, issued 0720 AM. 8.0 ft near 8 AM, 9.5 ft near 9 AM, 10.5 ft near 10 AM, crest 10.8 ft near 10:30 AM. Next issuance by 0900 AM or sooner.
NWS Flash Flood Warning (Damage Threat CONSIDERABLE) stays in effect for central Athens County until 12:45 PM.
Lot C: water ponding along the low edge by the trailers. The 9 Facilities trucks and 2 mobile generators are wherever Facilities last ordered them. A full move takes about 40 minutes.
Riverside Hall: 680 residents waking up, 08:00 classes across the Lower Quad. The desk phone keeps ringing. The basement laundry floor drain problem stays however Facilities left it.
Sugar Run Apartments (210 residents): under whatever advisory was issued at flood stage. If none was issued, none is in effect.
Dairy Lane barricade, Marlowe Fire alternate route for Engine 2 and the medic units, and the diesel tanker: all stand as decided. Anything not decided is still open.
Activation level, EOC staffing in Campus Services Building room 108, and every public message sent so far stay as they are.
fields.facilitatorNote: Do not add facts beyond this card. If a seat asks whether a Riverside order has been given, the answer is only what that seat or the IC has actually said or logged. Let the silence run if nobody brings up Riverside within the first few minutes. At 1.7 ft/hr the gauge reaches 8.0 ft at about 07:55.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ninety Minutes — Flash Flood, Evacuation & Campus Shelter

instructorNote: This card resets the room for Phase 3. Every seat should check its open items against the 0720 AM forecast, and the IC should confirm Level 1 Full (flood stage 7.0 has been reached), logging the time and basis if that has not already been done. Watch whether each seat names its next action tied to a stage, and whether anyone works back from the 8.0 ft Riverside trigger and the 10.5 ft forecast to set the decision time using the clearance time.
